authority.decision_scope: Bound mechanical constraints and explicit evidence dispositions; no CAD edits, no electrical rearchitecture, no fabricated-hardware claim
authority.authority_class: derived from external package contracts plus existing Rev-A product decisions

invariants.subject: L10 4.7uH inductor
invariants.statement: The integrated L10 XY occupancy is bounded by its current project footprint and courtyard; future package changes must fit the same or smaller bounded envelope unless Mechanical Authority reopens it.

z_envelope.reason: exact L10 MPN/package drawing/3D model is absent

invariants.verification: native courtyard/edge DRC plus exact MPN/model or dimensioned drawing before assembly release
invariants.prototype_validation: Confirm installed inductor body height and adjacent clearance during first article assembly.

invariants.subject: Y10 25 MHz crystal
invariants.statement: The integrated Y10 XY occupancy is bounded by its current project footprint and courtyard; any replacement must fit the same or smaller bounded envelope and preserve the XIN/XOUT/ground pad arrangement.

z_envelope.reason: exact Y10 MPN/package drawing/3D model is absent

invariants.verification: native courtyard/edge DRC plus exact MPN/model or dimensioned drawing before assembly release
invariants.prototype_validation: Confirm crystal body height and keepout during first article assembly; preserve oscillator electrical layout.

invariants.subject: J8 storage mode service interface
invariants.statement: J8 remains a four-contact on-board mode/service interface. The current schematic marks it in-BOM and on-board with DNP=false; DNP conversion is not authorized by this contract. The exact mating jumper/header accessory and service procedure remain required before release.

population_contract.DNP_requires: new schematic/BOM authority and explicit service procedure

invariants.verification: native schematic/PCB parity, selected accessory drawing, service-access review, and mode-control negative tests

invariants.subject: J1 SXM2 mating/rework boundary
invariants.statement: J1 is Amphenol/FCI 74221-101LF on the top side. Preserve the manufacturer mated stack height, connector courtyard, SXM2 insertion/mating direction, and the manufacturer rework boundary around the hidden-joint array.

service_boundary.rule: Keep access/rework ring and insertion path free of incompatible obstructions; no connector-height or mating claim from footprint alone.

invariants.verification: pad/courtyard overlay, exact connector model or dimensioned drawing, assembly/rework review, prototype mating validation

invariants.subject: J3 B-key M.2 mating/retention/service boundary
invariants.statement: J3 is the selected JAE B-key 2280 socket. Preserve its card insertion axis, 4.10 mm body height, B-key contact geometry, 2280 end datum, retention feature, underside component allowance, and service access for card insertion/removal.

service_boundary.known_current_issue: existing retained DRC census records J3/MECH_M2_2280 overlap and PTH-in-courtyard findings; this contract does not waive them

invariants.verification: native DRC against explicit 2280 envelope, exact drawing/model audit, populated-card insertion/removal review, prototype card fit

invariants.subject: Rev-A V100 cooler/backplate boundary
invariants.statement: Rev-A uses a module-mounted air or liquid cooler on the V100/SXM2 module. No carrier-mounted cooler, carrier backplate, proprietary cooler CAD, or generic underside exclusion is part of the current product contract.

required: confirm selected module cooler/backplate does not conflict with carrier standoffs/connectors
confirm thermal path and airflow/liquid routing before first power

invariants.verification: mechanical assembly review against selected cooler/module/standoff evidence and prototype bring-up thermal procedure

what_is_bound: J1/J3 manufacturer mating dimensions and service rules
what_remains_unproven: L10/Y10 exact MPN and Z heights
selected cooler/backplate fit and thermal assembly
